slot.brief: A telescope with objective and eyepiece of given focal lengths separated by a fixed distance; compute magnifying power and ask the condition for final image at infinity.

stem: An astronomical telescope has objective and eyepiece focal lengths $120$ cm and $6$ cm. In normal adjustment, what is the tube length and the magnitude of its angular magnification?

verdicts.working: In normal adjustment, tube length = 120 + 6 = 126 cm; angular magnification magnitude = 120/6 = 20.

working:
$$L=f_o+f_e=120+6=126\ \text{cm}$$
$$|M|=\dfrac{f_o}{f_e}=\dfrac{120}{6}=20$$

Independent check: In normal adjustment, tube length = 120 + 6 = 126 cm; angular magnification magnitude = 120/6 = 20.
